svg.aria-label: Five steps from a declaration to a running control. The primitives lane declares the behaviour, its strings and that it is a target. The registry refuses three things: a name the runtime does not implement, a control with no string to name it, and a target that does not say it is one. The renderer builds one control per node from the node's own tree text and the primitive's declared strings. The primitive places the finished node. One client module, and it renders nothing until the clipboard is actually there.
svg.text: A behaviour is declared in one lane and implemented in another
The copy button, from the declaration that asks for it to the one module in the runtime that runs in a browser.
the browser — one boundary, one module
loom.code says what it wants, and what that makes it
the registry refuses three things, before anything renders
a name the runtime does not implement · a control with no string to name it · a target that does not say it is one
the renderer builds one control per node
what it copies is textOf(node), read from the tree — never from the markup rendered around it
the primitive places it, and that is the whole of its part
loom.behaviours.copy — a ReactNode, with nothing left to configure
one "use client" module, and it does not show itself on faith
the server render is empty; the button appears once navigator.clipboard.writeText is actually there
A behaviour declared and never placed is reported by the audit, the way a declared slot nobody rendered already was.
